referenceExtraction.method: Python HTMLParser; main element text nodes, excluding script/style, joined with newlines

claims.identity: Pi classifier snapshot, independently implemented route
claims.contextWindow: 922000 is frozen Pi classifier metadata; not a tested service limit
claims.price: Decisions guide: input-only 0.10; general Luna model: >272000 full-request 2x input multiplier; independently yields 0.20. Chat output/cache rates are not imported. Regional premiums and billing are unobserved.
claims.images: 128 from Decisions API reference. PNG/JPEG/WebP are the barness supported subset, proven by public fixtures and own live only when run.
claims.score: 2–10 is the barness public subset, not an OpenAI maximum
claims.descriptions: strings are the native question format; public JSON descriptions remain route-specific
claims.assets: PNG/JPEG are deterministic synthetic 32x32 red squares encoded by Go standard library. WebP is the unchanged licensed x/image v0.45.0 gopher-doc.1bpp.lossless.webp; all are fully decoded and saved per call.
